grammar.summary: 本课学习表繁殖的 multiply 与 it was not long before。

points.title: It was not long before 表不久就
points.explanation: It was not long before the rabbits multiplied. 字面"不久之后……就"，叙事时间推进句式。

examples.en: It was not long before they spread across the country.
examples.cn: 不久它们就蔓延到了全国各地。

points.title: 表「引入」的 introduce 被动
points.explanation: they were introduced to the continent 动物的"人为引入"：introduce 被动表引进。

examples.cn: 这种病毒是人为引入的。
